rows.quote: Validation analyses were conducted using GWAS summary statistics from the FinnGen R12 release, including the six sepsis-related phenotypes available in this release: “Other septicemia”, “Streptococcal septicemia”, “Puerperal sepsis”, “Bacterial sepsis of newborn”, “Pneumococcal septicemia”, and “Hemophilus septicemia”.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the release used for the validation summary statistics; every other mention of a release in the passages gives the same one.

The passages give case and control counts and cite a cohort description and a prior study whose identifiers are none of any dictionary row's; no release, platform, year or accession singles out a row. Screen row reread; stays unresolved.
